title: Pizza for Hillary: Fundraiser Invitation (Podesta, Alefantis, April 10, 2016)
text: PLEASE JOIN US FOR PIZZA FOR HILLARY WITH John Podesta Campaign Chair AND Maya Harris Senior Policy Advisor AND SPECIAL GUEST Pizza Chef James Alefantis of Comet Ping Pong IN SUPPORT OF HILLARY FOR AMERICA Sunday, April 10, 2016 1:00 pm - 4:00 pm HOSTED BY MADDY BECKWITH, EZEKIEL EMANUEL, TONY PODESTA AND CHRIS PUTALA WASHINGTON, D.C. Address provided upon RSVP Ko CONTRIBUTION LEVELS CHAMPION - $2,700 INDIVIDUAL OR $5,000 PAC Includes Champion reception with John Podesta SUPPORTER - $1,000 INDIVIDUAL OR $2,000 PAC FRIEND - $500 INDIVIDUAL OR $1,000 PAC GUEST - $250 INDIVIDUAL OR $500 PAC
